correctness.rationale: Every proper Abelian border corresponds to a zero of the inward-pair difference walk. The center bit for odd lengths is independent. A weight-preserving reflection at the first zero gives 2u([z^0]+[z^1])[(1+uz)(1+u/z)]^(m-1); binomial expansion gives every layer. The alternating binomial-product coefficients prove the exact log-concavity equality cases. Vandermonde gives the exact variance; uniform Stirling gives the interior-density asymptotic. Executed actual package files verify/bruteforce.py (n<=18, all 524286 words) and verify/path_dp.py (m<=40) passed; computation is only auxiliary.

value.rationale: Full fixed-Hamming-weight enumeration naturally refines the earlier all-weight total for Abelian-border-free words, relevant to composition-constrained sources. The exact parity rigidity of log-concavity and the sharp 1/sqrt(m) conditional probability with density-dependent coefficient give a structural and quantitative boundary between balanced and imbalanced constraints. These are meaningful all-length statements, not an arbitrary finite slice.
